body: Any specific reason to use this? The more efficient way would be to use `get_child_count` and `get_child` and is used everywhere else, avoids creating temporaries and storing things

I'd change it to
```suggestion
			menu->add_icon_shortcut(get_editor_theme_icon(SNAME("ActionPaste")), ED_GET_SHORTCUT("scene_tree/paste_node"), TOOL_PASTE);
			menu->add_shortcut(ED_GET_SHORTCUT("scene_tree/paste_node_as_sibling"), 
			menu->add_shortcut(ED_GET_SHORTCUT("scene_tree/replace_node"), TOOL_REPLACE);TOOL_PASTE_AS_SIBLING);
```
also the new action should be called "Paste as Replacement", as already mentioned.
The replacement option should not appear for foreign nodes.
If replacement supports multiple nodes, the option should appear in context menu for multiple nodes (right now it doesn't). Also it should be a single undo action.

